import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
one=np.ones_like(t); L=np.log(P)
Pf={'PlnP':P*L,'P':P,'1/P':1/P,'lnP':L,'1':one}
def ex(w):
    s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
    cols=[];names=[]
    for k,v in Pf.items():
        for tk,tv in [('1',one),('t',t),('s',s),('c',c)]:
            cols.append(v*tv); names.append(k+'*'+tk)
    return np.column_stack(cols),names
def run(w):
    X,_=ex(w); co,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-X@co; return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
ws=np.linspace(0.05,1.5,300); v=[run(w) for w in ws]; i=int(np.argmin(v)); print('grid',ws[i],v[i])
res=minimize_scalar(run, bounds=(ws[max(i-2,0)],ws[min(i+2,299)]), method='bounded')
X,names=ex(res.x); co,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
print(res.x,res.fun); print([(n,round(c,4)) for n,c in zip(names,co)])
